cases.given: a searchable OutputDialog (script-output flavor) is open in browse mode with content loaded
cases.expected: the dialog enters query-edit mode, the footer shows the query echo starting with /, no close result is emitted, and following state is unchanged

cases.given: the dialog is in query-edit mode
cases.input: type the characters f j k g a n into the query
cases.expected: all six characters are appended literally to the query; no scroll, no follow toggle, no next-match, and no attach side effect occurs

cases.given: a live-run OutputDialog (runOutputAttachable=true) is open in query-edit mode
cases.expected: the letter a is appended to the query and no attachRunViewerCmd is enqueued — the app-level attach intercept is gated on !Editing()

cases.given: a live-run OutputDialog (runOutputAttachable=true) is open in browse mode with an accepted query
cases.expected: the app intercept fires and enqueues the attach command for the pinned session, unchanged from current behavior

cases.given: a dialog showing 10 lines where the query error matches lines 3 and 8, viewport showing lines 1-5
cases.expected: the dialog stays open (no OutputDialogResult), exits edit mode, scrolls so the first match is centered/highlighted, the footer shows match 1/2, and follow disengages because the jump is a manual scroll

cases.given: a dialog in browse mode (no query editing active)
cases.expected: the dialog closes and emits OutputDialogResult{} exactly as today — accepting a query is the only new Enter behavior and it only applies while editing

cases.given: a dialog in query-edit mode with a partially typed query
cases.input: press esc, then press esc again
cases.expected: the first esc leaves edit mode and returns to browse mode (query retained); the second esc closes the dialog and emits OutputDialogResult{}

cases.given: an accepted query with 4 matches, currently on match 2
cases.expected: n selects match 3 and centers it; N returns to match 2 — wrap is not triggered for interior moves

cases.given: an accepted query with 4 matches, currently on match 4
cases.expected: selection wraps to match 1, the view centers it, and the footer shows match 1/4 (wrapped) for that jump

cases.given: a dialog whose sanitized lines contain no occurrence of panic
cases.input: open search, type panic, press enter
cases.expected: the dialog stays open, the footer shows 0 matches with the query retained, the viewport does not scroll, and n/N are inert

cases.given: a dialog in query-edit mode with an empty query (or a query deleted to empty)
cases.expected: edit mode exits, the match list and query are cleared, no scroll occurs, and the footer returns to the normal browse help

cases.given: content where the identical line retrying in 500ms appears three times
cases.input: search for retrying and press n twice after accepting
cases.expected: each of the three identical occurrences is a distinct match and n visits match 2 then match 3

cases.given: a live-run dialog with an accepted query and 2 matches while the session is alive
cases.input: a runOutputRefreshedMsg arrives whose new tail contains 3 occurrences
cases.expected: SetContent recomputes the match list against the new sanitized snapshot; the footer now reports 3 matches and selection moves to the nearest surviving match if the previously selected line shifted

cases.given: a live-run dialog showing match 1/1 for a line near the top of the tail
cases.input: a refresh arrives in which the tail has advanced past the matched line so no occurrences remain
cases.expected: the footer shows 0 matches with the query retained, the viewport clamps to valid content instead of pointing at evicted lines, and no stale highlight is rendered

cases.given: a run tail where earlier lines have already been dropped by the bounded 400-line capture or the 64 KiB transcript bound
cases.input: search for a string that only appeared in the evicted portion
cases.expected: the search reports 0 matches — matches only ever index the current sanitized d.lines snapshot; the UI never implies access to dropped history

cases.given: a live-run dialog in follow mode at the bottom
cases.input: open search, accept a query that matches an earlier line, then press f
cases.expected: accepting the match jumps the view and disengages follow; pressing f in browse mode re-engages follow, scrolls to the bottom, and retains the query and match list

cases.given: a dialog in query-edit mode
cases.input: deliver a tea.PasteMsg containing EADDRINUSE followed by a newline and a second line
cases.expected: the paste is consumed by the overlay (does not fall through to the focused terminal), and the query receives the pasted text with the newline terminating the paste — equivalent to typing then pressing enter

cases.given: a dialog in browse mode
cases.expected: the paste is not consumed by the overlay (consumePaste=false), preserving today's fall-through-to-terminal behavior for the run-output flavor

cases.given: content containing the line failed — エラー: disk full
cases.input: search for エラー and accept
cases.expected: the match is found and highlighted using rune-span offsets; the correct display cells are highlighted with no byte-offset misalignment

cases.given: a dialog sized to a very narrow width (below the footer help width) with an accepted query
cases.expected: the query echo truncates with an ellipsis rather than overflowing, and match navigation still centers the matched line correctly

cases.given: the workspace-status flavor dialog (searchable=false) is open
cases.expected: nothing happens — / is unbound in a non-searchable dialog and the dialog stays in browse mode

cases.given: the composite script-output view with a section header '== setup — failed — exit 1 ==' style line
cases.expected: the section header line matches like any other line, letting users jump straight to the failed script's section
